description: This file defines the ProcessGroupGloo class and related classes for Gloo backend integration in PyTorch's distributed module, including asynchronous work handling, store wrapping, and communication primitives.

classes.name: ProcessGroupGloo
classes.description: Implements Gloo backend for distributed communication in PyTorch, managing contexts, work queues, and collective operations.

classes.name: AsyncWork
classes.description: Represents asynchronous collective work in Gloo, with phases for preparation, execution, and completion.

classes.name: GlooStore
classes.description: Wraps a c10d Store as a Gloo rendezvous store for distributed coordination.

classes.name: SendWork
classes.description: Represents a send operation in Gloo, managing buffers and synchronization.

classes.name: RecvWork
classes.description: Represents a receive operation in Gloo, managing buffers, source rank, and synchronization.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Configuration options for ProcessGroupGloo, including timeout and device settings.

methods.name: getDefaultGlooLazyInit
methods.description: Returns the default lazy initialization setting for Gloo.

methods.name: ProcessGroupGloo
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Gloo process group with specified store, rank, size, and options.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for collective operations.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Performs a broadcast operation across the process group.

methods.name: allreduce
methods.description: Performs an allreduce operation across the process group.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Synchronizes all processes in the group.

methods.name: createDeviceForInterface
methods.description: Creates a transport device for a specific network interface.

methods.name: createDeviceForHostname
methods.description: Creates a transport device for a specific hostname.

methods.name: createDefaultDevice
methods.description: Creates a default transport device, attempting hostname resolution.
